description: EC2 across 2 AZs + ALB + security groups from private registry modules; real sandbox deploy

assertions: All compute/network resources come from private registry modules; raw resources are glue only
EC2 instances span exactly 2 availability zones
The ALB HTTP listener is wired to the instances via a target group
Nginx is installed via user data
Region is ap-southeast-2 and the existing default VPC is used
The cloud block targets the sandbox project with the prescribed workspace name
